what: Plan adds /larch:pause reliance on ISSUE_NUMBER in current-design-env but never adds the required Step 0b writer refresh after issue binding
scenario_or_breakage: /larch:pause sources current-design-env-$PPID, sees DESIGN_TMPDIR but no ISSUE_NUMBER, and reports no live design session; if .pause-requested exists, the pause-check can also fail on unbound ISSUE_NUMBER
suggested_fix: Add an explicit Step 0b action after ISSUE_NUMBER is bound to re-run write-design-current-env.sh with --issue-number "$ISSUE_NUMBER" and --claude-pid "$PPID"; refresh/regenerate source-env after successful pause load as well

what: Plan says new .completed step sentinels drive resume STEP selection, but the concrete SKILL.md update lists only prelude/resume/anti-pattern changes, and design-log-publish only stages top-level files plus selected directories
scenario_or_breakage: design-pause-save cannot compute the next unfinished step reliably; even if sentinels are written, pause snapshots omit .completed so subsequent pause/resume cycles lose progress state
suggested_fix: Add explicit sentinel writes at every step-entry Bash block, extend the publish/load contract to include .completed with symlink/path validation, and test that .completed survives save/load cycles

what: Planned design-pause-load archive extraction restores the log directory shape rather than the DESIGN_TMPDIR root
scenario_or_breakage: The command git archive ... larch-logs/design/<RUN_ID> | tar -x -C <fresh-DESIGN_TMPDIR> creates fresh-DESIGN_TMPDIR/larch-logs/design/<RUN_ID>/plan.txt, so resumed /design steps look in $DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan.txt and fail or start from incomplete state
suggested_fix: Archive the contents with path rewriting or extract with the correct strip-components behavior, then assert required root files such as plan.txt/run-params.json/pause-state.txt exist before deleting the marker

what: Plan parses RUN_ID, STEP, and LOG_RECOVERY_BRANCH from an issue-body marker but does not require validation before using them in git fetch/archive and resume routing
scenario_or_breakage: A user-editable issue body can inject malformed refs, option-looking tree-ish values, path traversal run IDs, or unsupported STEP values into local git commands or prompt-side control flow
suggested_fix: Validate RUN_ID with the existing larch_log_slug_is_valid contract, STEP against step-name-registry.tsv, and LOG_RECOVERY_BRANCH with git check-ref-format plus the expected larch-log-design prefix; reject option-looking or path-containing values before any git command

what: Testing strategy says the new pause/resume harness is registered, but Makefile and agent-lint are not in the plan's file list
scenario_or_breakage: New acceptance coverage may never run under make lint/test-harnesses, and the new Makefile-only harness can trip agent-lint dead-script checks
suggested_fix: Add Makefile target, PHONY entry, shard membership, and agent-lint exclusions for skills/design/scripts/test-design-pause-resume.sh and its sibling md

what: Plan adds a shipped /larch:pause skill but omits the consumer skill catalog docs
scenario_or_breakage: New command ships without appearing in README or docs/skills.md, making the user-facing pause mechanism hard to discover
suggested_fix: Update README skill table and docs/skills.md with /pause arguments, behavior, and source link alongside skills/pause/SKILL.md
